description: Manual double-pole switch, 4HP: one button moves two separate signal paths at once, each picking one of two inputs

params.text: Each press moves both paths to the other input, alternating between the first and the second

inputs.text: Passed to the A output while the first of the two positions is picked
Passed to the A output while the second of the two positions is picked
Passed to the B output while the first of the two positions is picked
Passed to the B output while the second of the two positions is picked

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the two A inputs the SELECT button has picked
Carries whichever of the two B inputs the SELECT button has picked

notes: one channel only; a polyphonic cable at an input passes its first channel and drops the rest
